forms.detail: EUDA: the hydrochloride salt (CAS 53-21-4) is a white powder; DEA: a white, crystalline powder made from coca leaves; AIHW: cocaine is commonly found in powder form (Australia).

DEA photo captions show cocaine bricks (no further description in the text).
